name: Robert
text: the printer ran out of paper mid job n now theres a queue at reception, i put the last ream in but we need more b4 tomorrow, Robert

name: Kafa
text: the fridge in the staff room is making a weird noise n the door doesnt shut right, someone put a chair against it which isnt ideal, can we get it looked at this week, Kafa

name: Viatcheslav Prunotto
text: the new vending machine takes cards but the contactless pad doesnt light up n two ppl got charged twice, i rang the number on the side n they said a tech comes friday, till then maybe unplug it cos ppl keep trying. it ate my card twice as well, Viatcheslav Prunotto

name: Azhin Hortense
text: the lift keeps stopping at floor 3 with the doors half open n ppl are stuck waiting, its done it three times today, can someone log it proper, Azhin Hortense

name: Hulya
text: the urinal in the mens block is blocked again n the smell is drifting into the corridor, i put a cone out n shut the door, the plumber came last month for the same thing so its worth a complaint, Hulya

name: Maratsee
text: the big order for the cafe came in short again, two boxes of cups n no lids, i checked the delivery note n its signed for the full pallet so the driver must have miscounted, ive emailed the depot with photos, can u chase the credit, Maratsee

name: Sturminster Newton Stalbridge
text: the window latch in the back office has come loose n the window wont close flush, tape is holding it for now but it whistles at night, Sturminster Newton Stalbridge

name: Chehabeddine Gusberti
text: the hot water in the annex is lukewarm again n the showers are freezing by the time ppl get in, ive nudged the boiler thermostat up a notch n it helped a bit, we should get it serviced, Chehabeddine Gusberti

name: Meiko
text: the car park lighting on the top deck is out again so the far corner is pitch black, security walked it last night n said the same, the timer might be out of sync cos they came on at eleven instead of dusk, two bulbs probably gone as well, Meiko

name: Konle
text: the bike pump by the rack has gone walkies again n my tyres are flat, anyone got one i can borrow for ten mins, Konle

name: Satheeskumar Bouabbas
text: someones left a load of flattened boxes in the loading bay n the driver couldnt get the pallet truck through, i moved them to the yard for now but they need breaking down properly, can u sort it before the next delivery, Satheeskumar Bouabbas

name: Teweldemedhin Nouredine
text: the freezer alarm went off around two in the morning n nobody was on site so it rang for an hour, the stock is fine cos the door stayed shut but the log needs an entry, the sensor might need replacing as its done this twice now, can you check the alarm panel codes, Teweldemedhin Nouredine

name: Lassus
text: the till roll keeps jamming n weve gone through three rolls in two days, the slot looks bent, can we get a new printer, Lassus

name: Chris
text: The shed delivery was accepted at the gate and stacked by the side wall until the base is ready. The driver waited for a signature and left the paperwork in the office. The panels were counted twice and all present, as noted by Chris.

name: Brazzi
text: The boiler service passed and the readings were within range for the first time in two years. The engineer replaced a worn gasket and left the old part on the bench for inspection. A reminder has been set for next winter. The log book was signed and the job closed by Brazzi.

name: Subangi Argine Gigacher
text: The hanging baskets were watered before the weekend and the dead heads cleared. The brackets were checked and the loose one tightened, confirmed by Subangi Argine Gigacher.

name: Nijazija Deart
text: The delivery of sand was spread across the two new beds and the path was swept. The bags were folded and stored in the shed. Two barrows were left out and brought in the next morning. The tool count was checked by Nijazija Deart.

name: Asila
text: The road closure was extended by a day because the resurfacing ran into an old drain. The diversion signs were repositioned at the roundabout and the bus company was told in time. Two residents complained about the noise and both calls were logged. The final inspection was passed, recorded by Asila.

name: Notegen
text: The parcel shelf was cleared and the old flyers recycled. The new leaflets arrived folded this time, checked by Notegen.

name: Dayami Laouini
text: The battery on the floor scrubber was replaced under warranty and the old one taken away. The charge now holds for a full shift. The operator was shown the new charging routine and the manual was left in the cupboard, signed off by Dayami Laouini.

name: Rathees Kevin
text: The hall floor was mopped and the chairs reset for the morning booking. The stage curtains were rehung on the new track and the pulleys oiled. One spotlight was found to flicker under load and has been tagged for replacement. The caretaker confirmed the alarm sequence, logged by Rathees Kevin.

name: Sevdai
text: The hedge cutters were sharpened and returned to the rack. The fuel can was refilled and the split pin replaced, noted by Sevdai.

name: Zarate
text: The community noticeboard was emptied of out of date posters and the glass cleaned. The new timetable for the lunch club went up and the quiz sheets were left in the pouch. Two old pins were bent and replaced, maintained by Zarate.

name: Eponine Fredrika
text: The reading volunteers were given the new booklets and the shelf labels were reprinted in larger type. The summer challenge chart went up by the door and the first entries are already in. A donation of audio books arrived and was catalogued the same day. The quiet hour was extended, arranged by Eponine Fredrika.

name: Orlena Arapi Barak
text: The seeds were given out at the gate and the rota rewritten for the holiday weeks. Two new helpers joined the watering team, coordinated by Orlena Arapi Barak.

name: Kugathas
text: The bin store was cleared and the floor hosed down after the weeks of rain. The lids were all checked and two broken ones replaced. A note about the collection day change went on every door and the caretaker was told, supervised by Kugathas.

name: Nayil
text:
the coach for the away trip is leaving an hour earlier than the sheet says so spread the word tonite, a few ppl havent paid yet n the driver wants the list final, i can cover one seat if someones stuck, just let me know b4 eight, thanks,
Nayil

name: Diako
text:
the quiz sheets are done n the prizes are in the cupboard, can u print the answer grid b4 friday, thanks,
Diako

name: Guesry Vüllers
text:
the shared calendar is a mess with three overlapping bookings for saturday, i think the hall one wins but check with the group, can u tidy it tonight n message the ones affected, thanks,
Guesry Vüllers

name: Maevan Bon
text:
the veg box scheme wants a new pickup point n ours was flagged as too far from the road, i measured the path n its five metres short of the guidance so theyre right, can we shift the table to the front n try again, i think it will pass, thanks,
Maevan Bon

name: Zurijeta
text:
the keys for the boiler room have gone missing from the hook, did u borrow them, i need them b4 the inspection, thanks,
Zurijeta

name: Scotzniovsky
text:
the bbq in the yard was left uncleaned n the cover is ripped, i put the grate to soak but the cover needs replacing, whoever used it last should chip in for a new one, thanks,
Scotzniovsky

name: Yélèna Harsant
text:
the welly swap went really well n we shifted nearly thirty pairs, the leftovers are boxed in the porch n need taking to the charity shop this week, also someone left a blue pair that dont match anything, can u ask around b4 they go, thanks,
Yélèna Harsant

name: Lavan Rakovsky Linarello
text:
the pool keycard machine ate my card n spat out an error, can someone reset it b4 the morning swim, thanks,
Lavan Rakovsky Linarello

name: Wendolin
text:
the laminator is chewed up n the pouches are all stuck together, i salvaged the signs for the fete but it needs a service, can u log it with the office, thanks,
Wendolin

name: Sardano
text:
the spare room clear out is nearly done n weve got four bags for the tip, the old monitor works so maybe list it free online first, i can drop the bags off saturday morning if u leave them by the door tonite, let me know if that suits, thanks,
Sardano

name: Bonsu Nyaberi
text:
the church hall chairs are stacked six high n wobbling, someone will get hurt, can we strap them or move some to the vestry, thanks,
Bonsu Nyaberi

name: Felicien Nezirevic Körösi
text:
the minibus is booked for the trip but its showing as unpaid online, the money left our account on monday so its probably a lag, can u check with the hire place b4 friday, we cant lose the booking, thanks,
Felicien Nezirevic Körösi

name: Liwam
text:
The overnight checks were all completed and the gates were locked at nine. The courtyard lights were left on the timer and the heating went off as scheduled. A fox got into the bin store and the mess was cleared before opening. The incident was noted in the book for the morning team. Thanks,
Liwam

name: Sauveur
text:
The room was turned around in twenty minutes and the next group went in on time. All equipment was counted back, thanks,
Sauveur

name: Vaz Salgado
text:
The visitors were met at the gate and shown to the long room. The tea was set out and the sign in sheet was left by the door. The group left at four and the cups were washed and put away. Thanks,
Vaz Salgado

name: Vasilescu Ðelmo
text:
The first aid kit was restocked and the expired items were listed for the pharmacy. The defibrillator was checked and the pads are in date until next spring. Two plasters were used from the small kit and replaced. The cupboard was relocked and the key returned to the office. Thanks,
Vasilescu Ðelmo

name: Thomas
text:
The refuse was put out for the early collection and the containers were rinsed. The grit bin was topped up from the store, thanks,
Thomas

name: Kollias
text:
The paint cupboard was sorted and the half tins were labelled with the room names. Hazardous items were moved to the locked cage and the register updated. The brushes were cleaned and hung up to dry. Thanks,
Kollias

name: Kiebler Bryndza
text:
The water butt was emptied and scrubbed before the frosts. The tap was lagged and the overflow checked for the winter. Two new saplings were staked and the guards fixed. The tool shed was tidied and the spades oiled after the last planting. Thanks,
Kiebler Bryndza

name: Styve Herner
text:
The mats were swapped at both entrances and the wet floor signs dried off. The trolley was wiped down, thanks,
Styve Herner

name: Taya
text:
The tablets were counted against the sheet and the two gaps were reported to the nurse. The trolley was restocked from the store and the out of date dressings binned. The keys were signed back in at the office. Thanks,
Taya

name: Bisogni
text:
The lamps were tested and two tubes were replaced from the store. The fittings were dusted and the diffusers refitted. The emergency light by the fire door passed its test and the log was stamped. The electrician has been asked to quote for the flicker in the back office. Thanks,
Bisogni

name: Kalaiventhan Ryl
text:
The table plan was reprinted and the name cards folded. The favours were boxed and the menu board wiped clean, thanks,
Kalaiventhan Ryl

name: Van Enschot
text:
The speaker was tested with the loop and the hearing aid users confirmed it was clear. The spare batteries were given out at the desk. The room was reset with the chairs in a circle. Thanks,
Van Enschot
